quote_flags.quote: Yeah, ravine. At the ravine? Okay, yeah, yeah. So, I was thinking I could use my shortbow and take that guy out.
But he's kind of far, and I think I'll be able to make it. What do you… guys want to do? Do you have any better idea to tackle the situation?
Well… To explore that, you need to go close to him, and I think it's a bad idea going close to him.
I can sneak, but, well, yeah, yeah, I guess you're right, okay, I can… can go as close as possible. Let me try.
I mean, it makes sense, but I'm thinking if we can kill him without… Alerting others. Okay, yeah, I guess, I guess it doesn't matter either way, like, it's…
I feel using the mage hand is more effort. For the same output.
An orc would be bringing them food left, right, and center. But if you look inside, he's the one sitting next to the fire. And everybody's sort of listening to him.
